name: Example Dental Practice
_comment: A worked template, not a working configuration. Every value below is
specific to one practice: service numbering is the payroll's convention,
agenda ids come from that install's TAGPLAN, and the label rules are the
words that practice's staff type by hand. Copy this, then derive the real
values from the database with the exploration commands noted per section.
Point ZAWIN_PROFILE (or site config 'zawin_profile') at your copy.

company.name: Example Dental Practice
company._comment: abbr must match the Frappe Company record: ERPNext appends it to every Department name.

practice_day._comment: Minutes since midnight; fallback only. Per-agenda bounds are read from TAGPLAN.Start/Ende, which differ by discipline. Check with: zawin values TAGPLAN Start

services._comment: Payroll service code -> role and discipline. 'discipline: null' means the code is ambiguous and must be refined from ZaWin (e.g. an assistant pool spanning several disciplines). Set it where the pool should stay together whatever the agenda says — apprentices, for instance, are a department of their own so they do not count as capacity in a clinical one. 'clinical' marks staff who work chairside.

_comment_discipline_labels: (regex, discipline), first match wins, searched in the cleaned label of every presence row. This is how a practice's own shorthand — 'PRES ORTHO', 'PRES HD' — names a discipline for staff whose payroll service does not. Labels matching nothing here are still read: the words in them are matched against BEHANDLER.Initialen, so 'PRES CFO' inherits whichever discipline CFO is filed under, with no configuration at all. Check your own vocabulary with: zawin values TAGPLANTERMIN Beschreibung. The build also logs the commonest label words nothing claimed — anything there that names a discipline belongs in this list.
_comment_default_discipline: Where a bare 'PRES' puts someone. Most practices have one main floor that needs no marking in the agenda, and this names it. Set it to null instead if an unmarked label really means nothing at your practice — those rows are then left out of the count rather than counted for anyone.
_comment_disciplines: Disciplines that must exist even though no service, label rule or colour rule mentions them. Usually empty: a Department is emitted for every discipline named anywhere above, so autoshift's Discipline Branch Config always has something to link to.

role_color_rules._comment: BEHANDLER.FarbeTermin (default appointment colour, an OLE_COLOR int: R + G*256 + B*65536) -> what that colour says about the person. 'role' grants a Scheduling Role in addition to their designation-derived one, with optional 'max_rooms' overriding the role's default of 1. 'primary' instead makes the colour decide their discipline outright — for work that leaves no trace in the label, where the practice has already marked the person by colouring their agenda column. A rule may do either or both. Practice-specific judgement calls like this belong in a private companion profile (see cmdb_frappe), not here.

categories._comment: Names as they appear in TAGPLANTERMINKATEGORIE.Bezeichnung_1. List with: zawin categories

agendas._comment: TAGPLAN ids that are rooms, sites or purposes rather than a person's working day — they carry no working time. Find them with: zawin values TAGPLAN Beschreibung (look for mitArbeitszeit = 0).

site_behort._comment: BEHORT id -> branch name, for the ids that mean a site rather than a chair. List with: zawin values BEHORT Beschreibung

thresholds._comment: Defaults are reasonable starting points; verify each against your own data before trusting the output.

zawin._comment: BEHANDLER.Funktion code meaning prophylaxis, if this install uses one; null disables the check. Funktion is more reliable than matching initials suffixes. Inspect with: zawin values BEHANDLER Funktion. prophylaxis_discipline is the Department the resulting 'Prophylaxis' Scheduling Role belongs to; required only if funktion_prophylaxis is set.

_comment: Optional dotted paths to practice-specific *rules* — logic that cannot be expressed as data.
Each names a zero-argument factory returning an object implementing the matching protocol.
'branch' decides which site a shift was worked at (see pipeline/location.py BranchResolver);
omit it and every shift lands on the first entry in 'branches'.

overrides._comment: Optional paths, relative to this file, to human-confirmed corrections the matcher cannot infer — renames, and people whose real job differs from their payroll filing. These name identifiable individuals: keep them out of any public repository.
